answer_1.quote: we curate two datasets: HAICTrain ... annotated in our defined caption format by Gemini-1.5-Pro ... Furthermore, we generate 2,000 multiple-choice QA pairs ... by prompting and Gemini-1.5-Pro.
answer_1.outputs: video captions and multiple-choice QA pairs

answer_2.quote: For multiple-choice questions in MVBench, PerceptionTest, and HAICBench, we followed the prompting approach in LLaVA-1.5 and used accuracy as the metric. For ActivityNet-QA which features open-ended questions, we followed the evaluation protocol in Video-ChatGPT, utilizing GPT-4o-0513 to calculate accuracy.

answer_3.quote: Caption Evaluation, where the model generates a caption for each video, and an LLM (Gemini-1.5-Pro) answers questions based on this caption, thereby assessing caption ability based on QA accuracy.

answer_4.quote: Then, five human annotators assess the semantic relevance between videos generated by two captions, classifying them as "Good", "Same", or "Bad".
answer_4.guideline: The annotators are asked to make decisions upon the original videos in MovieGen.
